description: Rounded brown stones in a heap, which is all a Mosscairn amounts to once it stops holding itself together.
lore: Three. Not three each — three for the heap, and the heap weighs about what you do. So the money in rubble is not in the taking, it is in the carrying, and behind every crew there are men who have never [[lore/the_hard_pieces|opened a shape]] in their lives and make a steady living hauling other people's stone to the weighing-post at the road. There is one on the east road who has done it forty years. To anyone who calls it a poor trade he points out that he is paid per stone the same as the man who took it, sleeps a good deal better, and has never in all that time carried anything off a hillside except the weight.
